games.name: [TITUS]Storm▼ Inc.
games.desc:
Storm Inc. is a storm chasing game focused on realistic tornadoes,  with a mini scale aspect so YOU can watch scenarios unfold.

Across the map, storm chasers take to the roads in search of severe weather. Some prefer to watch tornadoes from a distance, while others get dangerously close to collect data or capture the perfect shot. With a variety of vehicles, weather radar, and unpredictable tornadoes, no two chases are exactly the same.

Whether you're intercepting tornadoes in an armored vehicle, collecting weather data, or simply trying to stay out of a storm's path, there's always a risk of getting caught in the middle of it.

Storms can change quickly, and even a relatively weak tornado can become dangerous if you're not paying attention.

Check out our social links below for updates, announcements, sneak peeks, and community discussions.

Storm Inc. is still in development. Expect bugs and changes.
